selection: Right member of every comparison pair is Atari 5200; left member is Atari 7800.
pixel_policy: Exact RGB crops. No drawing, color reduction, smoothing, interpolation, outline change, or sprite scaling.

native_encoding.rowmajor: Rows top to bottom; bytes left to right.
native_encoding.tiles: 4x8 native pixels per tile; tiles across, then down; each tile has eight row bytes.

Phoenix5200-Large-Bird-Sprites.png.order: Four columns, frame order left to right then down. Empty final cell is padding.

Phoenix5200-Various-Sprites.png.order: Frames 0,1,2,3 left to right. Seven small-pose rows at y=0..223; ship at y=224; shield at y=256; explosion at y=320.
